values.content: You are a data-driven career strategist. Provide actionable recommendations.

parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS market_analytics (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id UUID NOT NULL, analysis_date TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), period TEXT DEFAULT 'weekly', dashboard_data JSONB, total_applications INTEGER, best_source TEXT, top_skill TEXT, recommendations TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());
